reviews.text: I have been using Accurate Leak and Line since 2020 for all my plumbing and sewer issues. My personal rule is to always get more than one quote for any large job, and in all cases they were always competitive. Getting a quote has never been an issue and they were on-time for all of my projects. If you want the job done right the first time and want a warranty that is better than most, I would recommend giving them a chance.

We had a sewer line replacement of our 50+ year cast iron. Prior to that, we had a partial line replaced by another company, but upon their inspection, Accurate discovered that wasn't the case. We allowed Accurate to complete the job and we couldn't be more pleased! They were prompt arriving and completing the project and did exactly what they said they would do.
